fit.method: Bounded perspective model-only XY similarity against smoothed original SMASH stellar light; uniform XYZ scale
fit.score: Pearson correlation on observed footprint only; outside image is unconstrained
limitations: Authored image-to-simulation morphological placement, not astrometry or a recovered physical size/distance.
Original unresolved optical light approximates stellar morphology, with foreground sources/background and age/extinction biases.
All 225000 particles retained; outer tails outside observed footprint are unconstrained, not removed.
This placement changes model coordinates only and cannot prove physical depth or volumetric material quality.
